messages:
liz: Quick heads-up — draft RN for tomorrow's microrelease is in the doc, can folks eyeball? Need to lock pin + quiet window by EOD.

michael: on it, linking now. main ask: confirm we pin inference runtime to v2.11.4 for the canary.

samir: +1 on pin. v2.11.4 avoids the regression we saw with kv-cache on long context.

elaine: note for RN: include the rollback criteria (latency > 2x baseline or error rate > 1.5%). ops team requested explicit thresholds.

liz: added those thresholds to the bottom, thanks. Also added the short troubleshooting steps and the quick revert command.

deploybot: Deployment scheduled by @liz for 2024-02-15 22:00 UTC. Canary: 10% (region: us-west1). Command: `rb deploy --env=staging --tag=release-20240215 --canary=10`

ops-oncall: Quiet window requested 21:30-23:30 UTC. I'll be on standby. If we hit the latency threshold, we roll back immediately.

michael: one more check — are we shipping the small telemetry tweak? That changed token metrics; need a note in RN so Finance knows potential cost delta.

liz: yes shipping the telemetry tweak, added a bullet: "Telemetry: fine-grained token logging enabled — minor billing variance expected during first 24h."

samir: add a short canary checklist: healthchecks, p95 latency probe, token-rate sanity, and a fail-open test for model fallback.

liz: done — checklist added. Also added the exact rollback command and the owner list.

elaine: recommend we rehearse the rollback at 21:40 for a quick smoke before full ramp. 5min sim, then proceed if green.

ops-oncall: agreed, schedule a tiny rehearsal. I'll trigger the smoke after canary goes live.

michael: wording nit: change "minor billing variance" to "small transient billing variance" — less alarming in customer comms.

liz: updated copy. Final ask: can someone approve the internal announce blurb? I want to push the internal RN at 18:00 so PMs have time to prepare comms.

samir: approved.

elaine: approved, left a small grammar tweak.

ops-oncall: approved. I'm good with the timing.

deploybot: Reminder: to abort deploy before canary start run `rb cancel --tag=release-20240215`

liz: thanks team — will post the internal announcement at 18:00 and pin this thread. Leaving the doc link: https://redwood.example/docs/rn/2024-02-15-microrelease (internal) :thumbsup:

michael: :rocket: good luck everyone.

samir: will be watching metrics, ping me if anything odd appears.

ops-oncall: standby set. If rollback happens, I'll coordinate the postmortem and tag affected owners.

liz: I'll capture the short postmortem template in the RN so we can collect notes quickly if needed.

michael: thanks, team. Quiet window and pin locked.

liz: thread closed — will reopen if any last-minute changes.
